hero.eyebrow: on-device · in your browser · no backend
hero.title: Sanctions screening that runs entirely in your browser.
hero.lede: Screening a name usually means shipping your customers’ names to a third-party SaaS. AML-Filter turns that inside out. The sanctions list syncs in as a signed bundle, is ed25519-verified in the tab, and the matcher runs locally — so nothing you type leaves the device. Private, backend-free, and free to operate.
hero.audience: For small and medium-sized businesses with KYC obligations: onboard customers, screen sanctions locally, and keep customer data on the device.
hero.footnote: First load fetches the matcher model plus the signed bundle; after that both are cached, so later visits start fast. You still need a network connection to open the page — there is no offline mode.

infra.label: backend infra to run it
infra.sub: no API, no vector DB, no servers in the path

matcher.label: MiniLM matcher, cached once
matcher.sub: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 quantized ONNX, run in the tab

lists.fallback: Four public sanctions lists: US OFAC, EU, UN and the UK Sanctions List
lists.fallbackSub: read from the signed list catalog, verified in this tab

pii.label: of what you type leave the device
pii.sub: the name is matched entirely in the tab

private.title: Private
private.body: The name you screen is matched in the tab and never leaves the device. No query, no customer name, is sent to a third-party SaaS.

local.title: Local
local.body: Backend-free and in-tab. The model and the signed bundle download once and are then cached, so screening itself never calls a server. Loading the page does need a network connection — there is no offline mode.

verifiable.title: Verifiable
verifiable.body: The sanctions list arrives as a content-addressed, ed25519-signed bundle, verified fail-closed in-tab against a pinned key. A bad signature aborts the load.

workstation.title: Need the full workflow? The KYC workstation runs in your browser too.
workstation.lede: Onboard customers, auto-screen them against the signed sanctions bundle, and triage tiered matches on a review board — persisted to SQLite in your browser’s private storage (OPFS). No login, no server: your customer data never leaves the device.
